name: paradise
description: A small Claude Code and Codex plugin marketplace: a one-command terminal setup plus a handful of portable plugins for working with coding agents.

plugins.name: paradise
plugins.description: The setup door: one setup skill that installs the plugins you pick, applies a portable Claude Code baseline (settings, statusline, and a marker-bounded guidance block in your global CLAUDE.md, backed up first), sets up Codex when present, and hands off to terminal setup.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Portable productivity skills: handoff (compact the conversation for another agent), grill-me (stress-test a plan by interview), watch (a monitor outside the chat), explain (problem, mechanism, options, recommendation, then wait for the go), untangle (the agent's pile turned into small plain decisions, one at a time), and write-a-skill (author a skill to a short set of conventions).

plugins.name: terminal
plugins.description: Terminal skills: a shared WezTerm window for interactive logins, seeded chats in new Warp tabs, a per-agent Warp tab menu, and Warp and WezTerm setup.

plugins.name: project-guide
plugins.description: A simple standard for laying out, naming, and describing projects, with skills to create a new project to it or bring an existing repository up to it.

plugins.name: playwright-mcp-shared
plugins.description: Shared Playwright browser: one loopback-only Playwright MCP service and persistent Chrome profile shared safely by concurrent agent clients, with tab claims, an auth lease, a launch-tab dashboard, and on-demand browser start.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Long-term memory skills on a Hindsight memory bank: situate (catch up before work), remember and learn (save a source or a researched synthesis), and sweep (save what landed before a session closes). Needs a running Hindsight memory server (open source) that you host or reach; not part of the default setup.
